svg.text: Stand-in chuck, top view. 6061 aluminium disc, diameter 120 mm, thickness 10 mm, faced flat.
Three 2 mm dowel pins (ISO 2338, h8) pressed into 2.0 mm reamed holes, ends set 0.4 mm proud of the face (feeler gauge).
Centres in mm from the disc centre, x toward the robot is -x: A (-48.3, -10), B (-48.3, +10), C (0, +51).
Dashed: a seated 100 mm wafer (flat 32.5 mm, 47.3 mm from its centre). Pin faces touch the flat at x = -47.3 and the rim at y = +50.
Suction: a 1 mm deep, 3 mm wide ring groove at diameter 60 mm and a 3 mm hole through the disc to a hose barb (small diaphragm pump).
Toward the robot is to the left of the page; the left pin is at the top.
